WASM identities come from source_function_ids and decoded calls join actual WASM function index. Top key comes from actual Module issuer; snapshot root additionally checks actual top FunctionUnit pointer. Presentation labels do not recover body identities.

Original declarations use shared source_graph correspondence. Vendor cards match authentic original body geometry and refuse ambiguous candidates. Event bodies are selected by shared original event descriptors; repeated equal event rows retained. Caller names enter namespace lookup only in independently selected lexical compatibility mode.

The shared namespace_parts_from_proc and existence-checked resolve_command_with already own interpretation; replace local root prefix branching with shared root_unrooted_key. Authored lookup remains explicitly guarded lexical mode, no Native/original-source fallback.
